decision: Keep deterministic local rules for fixed tasks. No new local or self-hosted text model is approved or enabled by this assessment.

options.name: Deterministic local FAQs and validation
options.evidence: Existing bilingual FAQ, validation and workflow tests; no learned model needed.

options.name: Hosted generic drafting
options.evidence: Only fixed non-personal tasks and language leave the backend. General drafts still need user review.

required_evidence: Accuracy and task usefulness on held-out English/Hindi tasks, including refusals and clinically unsafe output; compare against rules and the current hosted baseline.
Security and privacy review: device/server isolation, encryption, access controls, logging, retention, telemetry/egress, model provenance, licence and prompt-injection boundaries.
Maintenance ownership: signed model/version, updates, patch cadence, monitoring, incident response and rollback.
Accessibility and reliability on target devices: screen reader, language quality, voice compatibility, offline failure messages, latency, memory and battery/thermal behaviour.
Measured compute/energy and financial cost for a defined task, hardware, workload and baseline. Include uncertainty and system boundaries before environmental comparisons.
environmental_claim: No measured water or carbon savings. Smaller/local is not automatically greener, safer or more private.
